description: TXN-LOCAL, dbPageTimeout on its own (the first card's PageTimeout step ran with dbLockRetry 20 and dbLockDelay 250 still set). Process a holds a transaction on row 1; b makes the conflicting UPDATE (dbFailOnError, Errors before/after) three times with engine defaults, three times after SetOption(dbPageTimeout 100) only, three times after SetOption(dbPageTimeout 10000) only, and three times with dbPageTimeout 100 plus dbLockRetry 3 and dbLockDelay 300, each attempt bracketed by Signal marks that carry the timestamps. Then a rolls back, b retries and reads, a reads after a pause and Idle. Asks the refusal time per setting and whether PageTimeout enters it at all.
